name: WebExtract
description: Hosted MCP that turns a public web page into clean Markdown (`page_markdown`) or fixed-schema JSON with article metadata, product name/price/availability and tables (`extract_url`). 20 free calls/day per caller IP with no signup or key; after that a prepaid Stripe-credit Bearer key, and the REST API also takes x402 USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, World Chain and Monad. Endpoint: `https://api.webextract.dev/mcp` · [Benchmark](https://webextract.dev/benchmark)
